reason: Portuguese football coach, head coach of S.C.U. Torreense (Liga Portugal 2) since January 2026. Won the 2026 Taca de Portugal final (2-1 after extra time over Sporting, 24 May 2026). Eight opened sources, including the official club site and press coverage. Known in Portugal mainly for football, no crime or scandal.

birthDate.note: FotMob gives 19 September 1978. Press ages differ: 45 (soccerway-sub23, early 2026), 47 (abola-renewal, rtp-renewal), 48 (fotmob, Oct 2026). The FotMob date matches the age of 48 on 2026-10-27. Wikipedia also gives this date but is not used as a source.

gapNote: Current top results are mostly Wikipedia, stats sites and short match reports. Few sources give a full career timeline or his background before Torreense. The page is worth writing for the 2026 Taca de Portugal win by a second-tier club and his rise from Torreense Sub-23 coach to head coach. Open conflict: a Record sidebar mentions he is leaving Torreense (João Nuno expected to succeed), while A Bola and RTP report a renewal to 2028. Do not state the departure as fact. Birthplace (Lisbon) is only in Wikipedia, so it is left null.
